description: This file contains extension methods for setting up Azure Table Grain Directory in an Orleans silo builder, allowing configuration and registration of Azure Table based grain directories.

classes.name: AzureTableGrainDirectorySiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for ISiloBuilder to configure Azure Table Grain Directory.

methods.name: UseAzureTableGrainDirectoryAsDefault
methods.description: Configures the silo builder to use Azure Table Grain Directory as the default, with options configured via a callback.

methods.name: UseAzureTableGrainDirectoryAsDefault (overload)
methods.description: Overloaded method that accepts an OptionsBuilder to configure AzureTableGrainDirectoryOptions.

methods.name: AddAzureTableGrainDirectory
methods.description: Adds Azure Table Grain Directory to the silo builder with a specified name, and configuration options via callback.

methods.name: AddAzureTableGrainDirectory (overload)
methods.description: Overloaded method that accepts an OptionsBuilder to configure AzureTableGrainDirectoryOptions.
